utility: Observed net USD/oz for the fixed common120 action contract; divide by known frozen R only for normalization; recover money with current R.
empty: Zero modeled PnL with 2s pending occupancy under inherited explicit no-fill assumption; not a flat-market label.
censored: Unknown terminal liability; never zero or NEITHER. Complete-case summaries are conditional on observed outcomes, not a correction for informative missingness.
pair: C=(uL+uS)/2, D=(uL-uS)/2. Estimate conditional means c(X),d(X), then qL=c+d,qS=c-d. c+abs(d) is the one-entry expected-value gate versus immediate WAIT=0.
oracle: E[max(0,uL,uS)|X] is not max(0,E[uL|X],E[uS|X]); hindsight opportunity is diagnostic only, not an instruction to trade.
joint_state_role: Realized paired sign taxonomy at zero net threshold. UNKNOWN is an observation mask, not a market class. Near-equal values are a separate diagnostic, not an automatic veto.
maturity: COMPLETE at actual exit publication; EMPTY at pending deadline. Pair known only after both mature. All time fields are exact nullable Int64.
dependence: Retain original rows and exact same-clock/same-risk weights; use chronological day/week blocks and purge label windows for evaluation. Five exposed days cannot establish uncertainty bands or economic admission.
